title: Airbnb Fee Switch Reprice Board
oneLiner: A host pricing board that recalculates nightly, cleaning, and event rates after Airbnb's host-only fee shift.
targetUser: Airbnb hosts, Superhosts, STR operators, co-hosts, and small property managers using dynamic pricing or PMS/channel-manager tools.
keyUX: The host imports calendar dates, floor rates, cleaning fees, event weekends, and current payouts; the app shows where the 15.5% host-only fee is underpriced, suggests rate changes, and flags dates where dynamic pricing failed to compensate.
signalRefs: S1 - Airbnb Resource Centre host-only service fee switch
S2 - Reddit r/airbnb_hosts seller fee and dynamic pricing concern
S3 - Reddit r/ShortTermRentals cleaning fee percentage pain
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive web app prototype for "Airbnb Fee Switch Reprice Board," a host pricing board that recalculates nightly, cleaning, and event rates after Airbnb's host-only fee shift. Include: fee switch status header, listing calendar heatmap, cleaning-fee break-even calculator, dynamic pricing mismatch detector, scenario cards for full offset/partial offset/occupancy protection, guest-visible total comparison, PMS update checklist, and owner decision log. Design direction: use the financial-analyst profile with calendar-linked margin math, compact payout deltas, restrained warning colors, spreadsheet confidence, and Airbnb-host-specific pricing cues; it should feel like a revenue-protection board for a working host, not a generic travel dashboard.
